communes: Granja Nova E Vila Chã Da Beira

blurb.text: A DOC in the northwest of the Beiras region. Its white wines have traditionally gone into the base blends of Portuguese sparkling wine, and it allows wine and sparkling wine. The wines of its former Encostas da Nave area are very like those of the Douro.
